notes.title: 🔞 How to Unlock All the Girls’ Scenes in Only Aprons
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, guests of Milk Milk Coffee! [/h3]

Thank you so much for warmly welcoming the game’s release!

As we mentioned, our goal was to create a cozy, emotional story in the style of an anime series. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2778850/One_Iced_Latte_With_Your_Breast_Milk_Please]One Iced Latte[/url] does not contain sex scenes, but the game hides four erotic scenes where Moka and Karina visit Katsuki’s home wearing nothing but aprons.

To unlock them, donate 100,000 yen at the shrine on days 40 and 47. Make sure you have enough money in your wallet on those days so the event triggers properly. You won’t see the full illustration if SFW mode is enabled.

notes.title: SFW Mode, Discord, and Release
notes.content:
[h3]Hi, Azaly and Nemuaki here![/h3] We originally planned to release [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2778850/One_Iced_Latte_With_Your_Breast_Milk_Please/][b]One Iced Latte With Your Breast Milk, Please![/b][/url] on February 21, but we ran into some issues with Steam page moderation. We’ve seen how much you’ve been waiting for the release, and we’ve been just as excited! We’ll publish the game as soon as possible. Sorry for the delay!

[h3]In the meantime, let us tell you a bit more about the game.[/h3]

First of all, One Iced Latte is a story-driven game without explicit sex scenes or depictions of genitalia. However, it does contain erotic elements that might not be suitable for streamers. Since we’d love to see your playthroughs live, we’ve added a safe mode that censors some suggestive illustrations featuring covered nudity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950551/5812639762aa8e48073b4df5ad27d77c28de3497.png[/img]
Second, at launch, the game will be available in at least English, Russian, Korean, and Japanese. Additional translations are in progress. If you’d like to translate the game into your native language or report any translation errors, please reach out to us!

And now, you can do that… in our brand-new [url=https://discord.gg/BHAC3Zg2bB][b]Discord server[/b][/url]! Come join us!

Thank you! Milk Milk Coffee will be opening its doors for you very soon! ☕💕

notes.title: Five Hidden Details from the #OneIcedLatte Demo You Missed
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3237150/One_Iced_Latte_With_Your_Breast_Milk_Please_Demo/

[h1]Five Hidden Details from the #OneIcedLatte Demo You Might Have Missed:[/h1]

[list]
[*] The names of all the main characters contain the kanji 珈, which means "coffee." Katsuki is written as "moon coffee," Moka as "strawberry coffee," and Karina's name encodes the words "coffee," "jasmine," and "Nara". When they first meet, Moka writes her name on the cup from left to right, while Katsuki meticulously writes his surname from top to bottom.

[*] When they first meet, Mary lectures Moka that in Tokyo, it's not customary to say everything that's on your mind. However, throughout the story, it's actually the older sister who is always straightforward, while the younger one has a sharp tongue and understands people's feelings well.

[*] Mary Mee is one of the characters from the game [i][b]Lewd Girls! Leave Me Alone![/b][/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1553890/

[*] Katsuki brings home a cup that once held Moka's iced latte. That evening, it replaces his usual cup next to his laptop. What happened to it afterward remains unknown.

[*] On the last day of the demo, you can notice [spoiler]Katsuki's approaching heart attack through[/spoiler] the disappearing energy indicators during his conversation with Moka and the increasing trembling of the heart-shaped affection indicator.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
We've noticed that our game has captured the interest of players from around the globe. We're committed to translating the game into multiple languages, though this might take some time post-release. If you're interested in helping us translate the game into your native language, please get in touch with us via email [spoiler]anityper@gmail.com[/spoiler]
